tolerance_note: H1 strict (1e-10) — paper claims operate on H1 loops; H0 relaxed (1e-6) to absorb persim/ripser float32 floor (~1/2^25 = 2.98e-8) from H0 diagonal-matching of extra near-duplicate features. Operationally negligible (H0 lifetimes are O(20+) in our data).

first_run_under_n_perm_shortcut.note: 2026-05-30 initial run; n_perm shortcut path superseded by external-indexing per length-matched-dedup-via-n-perm contract.

second_run_under_external_indexing_with_.note: 2026-05-30 second run; the H1 deviation traced to compute_rips_ph auto-thresh (75th percentile from a 500-pt random subsample, computed per-call) producing different cutoffs on X (L=5000) vs X[I] (L=4861). Confounder removed in third run by calling ripser.ripser directly.

third_run_under_external_indexing_direct.note: 2026-05-30 third run; canary-passing values under external-indexing + direct ripser. H0 deviation is the persim/ripser float32 floor; H1 is exact.
